title: Bounded fixed-module complexes with constructible sheaf origins have derived origin
statement: Let X be any scheme and Lambda a finite commutative ring. Let K be a bounded derived complex of fixed Lambda-module sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Assume that for each integer n there is a globally constructible etale Lambda-module sheaf F_n [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] with nu* F_n isomorphic to H^n(K) [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Then K is isomorphic to nu* L for an etale derived complex L that is bounded and has globally constructible cohomology [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

proof.text: The bounded constructible etale objects form a triangulated subcategory. Their image under exact inverse image is triangulated as well: lift arrows between origins by the bounded-below Hom bijection, take a distinguished cone, and compare its image cone using a morphism of triangles. Shifts and a zero object stay in the image.

Apply the existing bounded devissage theorem DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded to that triangulated image. The proof is the finite truncation induction: split off an extreme cohomology sheaf, use the cohomology long exact sequence to shorten the interval, and use triangulated closure. The base case is the shifted single complex of the sole nonzero cohomology. A single complex on nu* F_n is the inverse image of the single complex on F_n by exact single-complex compatibility. This proves the claimed origin, including acyclic complexes.

    {K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))}
    (hK : _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded K)
    (hH : ∀ n, ∃ F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), IsConstructibleSheaf F ∧
      Nonempty ((ν^*(X)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F ≅
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj K)) :
    boundedConstructible (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X K
